A shopkeeper offers you tea. Now what? 🇹🇷

▪️ No obligation: To buy. Accepting tea doesn't mean you must buy.

Text:
Driving here with your home licence? 🇹🇷

▪️ The rule: 6 months from entry. A foreign licence is generally valid for 6 months from your entry date.
▪️ Staying longer?: Convert your licence. Residents should convert it to a Turkish licence.
▪️ Always carry: Licence + passport. A notarised translation can also help at police checks.
